dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Welcome to PLEXON.
dashboard.platformInsightsSubtitle: One project list — CHECKION and AUDION as capabilities on the same Collection.
dashboard.platformInsightsEmpty: No projects yet — join an organization or get assigned to a Collection. New projects always link CHECKION and AUDION.
dashboard.platformInsightsLegacyHint: Product-only legacy — not a PLEXON Collection yet.
dashboard.productPlexonDescription: Central control plane for identity, profiles, usage, and cross-product entry points.
dashboard.productAudionDescription: Federated AUDION entry with PLEXON identity, profile sync, and central usage reporting.
dashboard.productCheckionDescription: Federated CHECKION entry with PLEXON identity, profile sync, and central usage reporting.
dashboard.productVideonDescription: Planned platform onboarding for VIDEON through the same registry, identity, and usage contracts.
dashboard.productBrandionDescription: Planned platform onboarding for BRANDION through the same registry, identity, and usage contracts.
dashboard.centralUsersSubtitle: One account for all services (CHECKION, AUDION, VIDEON). Register here only; sign in there with the same credentials.
dashboard.checkionNotConfigured: CHECKION is not configured. Set CHECKION_API_URL and CHECKION_ADMIN_API_KEY in the environment.
dashboard.centralNotConfigured: Database not configured. Set DATABASE_URL for central user management.
dashboard.name: Name
dashboard.companyProfileHint: Free-text profile label. For platform projects and access, use the organizations below.
dashboard.organizationsSubtitle: Membership in an organization; required for platform projects and team access.
dashboard.deleteUserConfirm: Really delete this user? All related data (projects, scans) will be removed.
dashboard.entitlementsSubtitle: Controls visibility, activation, and launch context per product.
dashboard.projectAssignmentsSubtitle: CHECKION: same project id as under “Projects” (container for scans, GEO, SEO). AUDION: your persona project UUID.
dashboard.productProjectPickerConcept: The list includes synced platform projects and — if CHECKION_DATABASE_URL and AUDION_DATABASE_URL are set on PLEXON — all CHECKION/AUDION projects read directly from each product database.
dashboard.productProjectPickerEmptyBound: No platform projects with a product binding yet — create and sync platform projects in the org admin first.
dashboard.usageSubtitle: Your token usage per service and month (e.g. CHECKION, AUDION).
dashboard.usageSubtitleAdmin: Token usage of all users per service and month.
dashboard.usageAdminEventsSubtitle: Raw usage events from Checkion, Audion, and Videon (newest first).
dashboard.usageAdminEventsEmpty: No usage events in the database yet.
